cohort: COVID-19-positive pregnant women admitted to a tertiary referral center in South India between April and September 2020
finding: COVID-19 generally had a mild course in pregnancy, but severe cases could deteriorate rapidly; there was evidence of community spread, and COVID-19 seemed to increase cesarean section rates.
mod_finding: Neonatal COVID-19 transmission appeared higher following vaginal deliveries, rooming-in, and breastfeeding.
followup_time: Until discharge after delivery (varied, but most discharged between 8 and 14 days post-admission)
